matches.rationale: The ground-truth defect is a computational misuse of reference frames. Findings 1, 4, 6 and 7 identify concrete symptoms of that same defect: the Etherington/angular-distance inconsistency, the unrecorded frame change in the solid-angle equations, the spurious metric-evolution term used to treat comoving galaxies as moving, and the invalid global solid-angle magnification from the aberration law.

pred_verdicts.rationale: Detects the frame-induced inconsistency that breaks the Etherington relation.
Correctly identifies an eq. (45) inversion error unrelated to the reference-frame defect.
Correctly identifies a Doppler-factor typo in eq. (4), not the reference-frame defect.
Explicitly identifies the unrecorded frame change making eqs. (26) and (28) inconsistent.
Correctly identifies a transcription slip in eq. (36), unrelated to the reference-frame defect.
Identifies the spurious metric-evolution four-velocity term used to treat galaxies as moving in a different frame.
Identifies the invalid global application of the local aberration solid-angle law, a downstream consequence of the reference-frame error.
Correctly identifies a typo in the definition of I_G, unrelated to the reference-frame defect.
